platformManagedCookies.purpose: Cloudflare may set strictly necessary security or bot-management cookies at the edge; storefront code does not read or control them.
Stripe may set strictly necessary checkout, fraud-prevention, or payment-session cookies on Stripe-controlled domains after handoff.

forbidden: first-party authentication, cart, checkout, analytics, advertising, fingerprinting, or replay cookies
reading or branching on the Cookie header in worker/index.ts or api/checkout.ts
setting Set-Cookie from the storefront or checkout boundary
copying Cloudflare or Stripe cookie values into application logs, metadata, or customer records
using a cookie as payment, inventory, price, shipping, or order authority
notes: Checkout remains explicit and stateless: Origin validation, canonical catalog lookup, and checkoutAttemptId idempotency are authoritative.
Provider-managed cookies do not grant the repository permission to inspect or reproduce them.
A future customer account requires a separately approved server identity boundary and new manifest.
